-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #10 / Scene #1 - Function Phindos
function Phindos()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("town001D.fld")
	MoveCamera(0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	RotCamera(0.00, 1.57, 100.00)


	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	OpenTalkScene(1, 1)
	OpenTalkScene(1, 2)
	OpenTalkScene(1, 3)
	OpenTalkScene(1, 4)
	OpenTalkScene(1, 5)
	OpenTalkScene(1, 6)
	OpenTalkScene(1, 7)
	OpenTalkScene(1, 8)
	OpenTalkScene(1, 9)
	OpenTalkScene(1, 10)
	OpenTalkScene(1, 11)
	OpenTalkScene(1, 12)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(Phindos)
